description: This file defines a set of asynchronous functions for research task orchestration, including generating search queries, executing web searches via Tavily, synthesizing findings, and handling parent-child task dependencies within a research workflow. It utilizes an agent router with reasoning capabilities and integrates with external modules like Tavily and schemas for structured data.

methods.name: generate_search_queries
methods.description: Generates focused web search queries based on research question, task description, and optional dependency context.

methods.name: execute_search
methods.description: Performs web searches for a list of queries using Tavily API and aggregates results.

methods.name: synthesize_findings
methods.description: Synthesizes search results into structured research findings with citations and confidence assessment.

methods.name: execute_research_task
methods.description: Coordinates the process of generating queries, executing search, and synthesizing findings into a final task result.

methods.name: synthesize_from_dependencies
methods.description: Creates a synthesized answer for a parent task based on child task findings without web search.

methods.name: execute_research_task_with_context
methods.description: Performs research with enhanced search queries using dependency context to improve results.
